_about: h4_swirlprism (order 1200) on R^4. Copy k of the domain is elements[k] applied to the half-cell; elements[0] is the identity. A point with barycentric weights beta in the domain is normalize(beta @ cell_vertices); the same point in copy k is elements[k] @ that point. multiplication and inverse tables, and the 2400 beta maps of G and G.Q, are in group.npz.
